title: DRE-LZSH: SEEG benchmark dataset for drug-resistant epilepsy (ictal and interictal segments, 29 patients)
description: DRE-LZSH is a stereo-EEG (SEEG) benchmark dataset from 29 patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, containing ictal (seizure) and interictal segments recorded at 2000 Hz. It includes clinical information and channel-level epileptogenic zone annotations, and all patients had Engel class I surgical outcomes. The data are re-packaged in iEEG-BIDS from the authors' Zenodo release, together with the authors' HFO detection results and code.
methods_description: SEEG was recorded at 2000 Hz from 29 patients, with seizure segments typically 40-60 s and longer interictal segments. The original MATLAB arrays were converted losslessly to BrainVision float32 with BIDS sidecars. No filtering, resampling, re-referencing or channel removal was applied.
